title: Cart
intro: {{products}} from {{stalls}}. Pick a pickup time for each stall, then place the orders.

split.title: Your cart will be split into 2 orders at 2 different stalls.
split.text: Each stall has its own pickup time and cutoff, and accepts its order separately. You pay each stall on pickup.

cutoffNote: {{stall}} closes orders {{hours}} hours before the slot. For {{slot}} on {{slotDay}} that is {{cutoff}} on {{cutoffDay}}.

summary.title: Pay at the stalls on pickup

ready: Both stalls have a pickup time. Each stall confirms its own order.
notReady: Choose a pickup time at {{stall}} to place your orders.
stockNote: Stock is taken out of the stall's count the moment you place the order. There is no online payment.
